770-2226-2397.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
770-2226-2397.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Man-o'-War by paying its mana cost.
When Man-o'-War enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1829-4279-6112--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1829-4279-6112--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7234.easyPrerequisites: There are a total of at least X cards in all hands.
6495-6972-7234.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Realm Seekers.
When Realm Seekers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7234.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2935-4695-8089.description:
Activate Ethereal Champion by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

4009-4574-4659-6769-6842.notablePrerequisites:
There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
You control at least three artifacts.
4009-4574-4659-6769-6842.description:
Cast Mox Opal by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Opal enters, Surge Conductor triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artfacts you control.
Activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mox Opal, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mox Opal from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Mox Opal.
Repeat.

431-1308-4772-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1308-4772-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1920-2060-4222-5328-7803.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Attentive Sunscribe.
Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
1920-2060-4222-5328-7803.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Repeat.

670-1619-5887-6136.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-5887-6136.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Avenging Hunter until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing Avenging Hunter to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Avenging Hunter until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

3705-4050-5997-7646.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7060-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7060-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-7060-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

140-586-5258-5618-6797.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat from step 2.

57-647-4846-5904.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
57-647-4846-5904.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3921-7009-7068.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
3921-7009-7068.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Winding Constrictor.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

3358-4881-7060.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

413-5571-7046--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
When the undying creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

3908-3963-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
3908-3963-7009.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3908-3963-7009.description:
Activate Spark Double using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Meneldor.  Meneldor triggers, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

2866-3200-3967-4986.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with two or more charge counters on it

132-198-1995.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {W} for each charge counter on it
Activate Myr Welder by paying {2}{W}, untapping it.
Repeat.
132-198-1995.notes: You can start the combo with fewer charge counters on Myr Welder but will need additional mana to compensate.

1884-2060-2919-4222.description:
Activate Silent Attendant by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Silent Attendant.
Repeat.

2530-2577-2741-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
2530-2577-2741-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Essence Warden, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Essence Warden and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

1789-2511-4875-5649.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-2511-4875-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

483-2034-3097-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-5173-5553-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1805-1978-3789.description:
Animate Pyramid of the Pantheon using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat from step 2.

3086-3175-4605-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Lagrella.
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it and Preston triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Sun Titan until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Lagrella that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Lagrella into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Lagrella is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Sun Titan is returned to the battlefield from exile.
Sun Titan, Lagrella and Preston each trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sun Titan that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sun Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, choosing to return nothing to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on the nontoken Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger from step 8, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3003-4050-4331-5031.notablePrerequisites: Skitterbeam Batallion in hand.You control at least nine artifacts.
3003-4050-4331-5031.description:
Cast Skitterbeam Batallion by paying {0}.
Skitterbeam Batallion enters the battlefield, creating two token copies of it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the two Skitterbeam Batallion tokens, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Skitterbeam Batallion from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

938-3771-4050.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
938-3771-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Marang River Prowler, adding {U}.
Cast Marang River Prowler from your graveyard by paying {U}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.
